description: Revert to the aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) with Depth 10, as the conservative 0.06 LR under-utilized the 5-minute budget; the aggressive LR historically converges faster to a lower loss floor (targeting ~0.983) within the time limit, while maintaining the stable WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to prevent early divergence.
